story.story:
Little Red Riding Hood’s mother tucked bread and a small cake into a wicker basket. “Take these to Grandmother’s cottage, and stay on the forest path.” Red tied her scarlet hood and set off.

Under an oak tree, a wolf stepped onto the path. “Where are you going?” he asked.

“To Grandmother’s cottage beside the three birch trees,” Red replied.

“Why not bring her flowers?” suggested the wolf. While Red picked daisies, he raced ahead.

At the cottage’s green front door, the wolf knocked and called in a sweet voice, “It’s Little Red Riding Hood!”

“Lift the latch,” Grandmother answered from bed.

The wolf rushed inside and swallowed her whole. He put on her nightcap, pulled her quilt over himself, and waited.

Red arrived, pushed open the green door, and placed her basket on the wooden table. She approached the bed.

“Grandmother, what big ears you have!”

“All the better to hear you with.”

“What big eyes you have!”

“All the better to see you with.”

Red gripped her cloak. “What big teeth you have!”

“All the better to eat you with!”

The wolf sprang up. Red screamed, but he swallowed her whole. Then he fell asleep, snoring loudly.

A passing woodcutter heard the snores and entered through the green door. Seeing the wolf’s swollen belly, he carefully snipped it open. Red scrambled out, then helped Grandmother climb free. Trembling with relief, they hugged.

They filled the sleeping wolf’s belly with stones. When he awoke, he stumbled and fell dead.

Grandmother shared the cake with her rescuers. Red promised never to wander from the path again.

blocking.title: Little Red Riding Hood
blocking.style: Watercolor and colored-pencil storybook illustrations; woodland greens, warm cream, and a scarlet cloak; soft morning sunlight outdoors, cool shadows inside the cottage, and warm light after the rescue.

entities.name: Stones placed in the wolf’s belly

blocking.story:
Little Red Riding Hood’s mother tucked bread and a small cake into a wicker basket. “Take these to Grandmother’s cottage, and stay on the daisy-lined forest path, where daisies grow wild.” In the cottage, Grandmother’s nightcap and quilt lay on her bed, and her bedside sewing basket held a needle and thread. Red tied her scarlet hood and set off from home onto the forest path, carrying the basket with the bread and cake still inside.

Under an oak tree, a wolf stepped onto the path. “Where are you going?” he asked.

“To Grandmother’s cottage beside the three birch trees,” Red replied.

“Why not bring her flowers?” suggested the wolf. While Red picked daisies, he raced ahead.

At the cottage’s green front door, the wolf knocked and called in a sweet voice, “It’s Little Red Riding Hood!”

“Lift the latch,” Grandmother answered from bed.

The wolf rushed inside and swallowed her whole. He put on her nightcap, pulled her quilt over himself, and waited.

Red arrived, pushed open the green door, and placed her basket on the wooden table. She approached the bed.

“Grandmother, what big ears you have!”

“All the better to hear you with.”

“What big eyes you have!”

“All the better to see you with.”

Red gripped her cloak. “What big teeth you have!”

“All the better to eat you with!”

The wolf sprang up. Red screamed, but he swallowed her whole. Then he fell asleep, snoring loudly.

A passing woodcutter heard the snores and entered through the green door. Seeing the wolf’s swollen belly, he took a pair of shears from his belt and carefully snipped it open. Red scrambled out, then helped Grandmother climb free. Trembling with relief, they hugged.

They filled the sleeping wolf’s belly with stones gathered from outside the cottage. Grandmother stitched the wolf’s belly shut with a needle and thread from her bedside sewing basket. When he awoke, he stumbled and fell dead.

Grandmother shared the cake with her rescuers. Red promised never to wander from the path again.

asset_specs.name: Little Red Riding Hood
asset_specs.height: A small child, a little over half the height of a grown person.
asset_specs.spec: Red is a small, slim girl with a round, fair-skinned face, rosy cheeks, brown eyes, and chestnut-brown hair in two short braids ending at her shoulders. She wears a knee-length scarlet cape with an attached hood, secured beneath her chin with scarlet ties. Beneath it are a warm-cream blouse, a moss-green skirt, cream stockings, and sturdy brown lace-up boots. Her hood and cape are plain scarlet, without patterns or decorative trim.

asset_specs.name: Little Red Riding Hood’s mother
asset_specs.spec: Mother has an average build, a fair-skinned oval face, brown eyes, and chestnut-brown hair gathered into a low bun. She wears a long sage-green dress with fitted long sleeves and a simple warm-cream apron tied at the waist. Plain brown leather shoes show beneath her ankle-length hem.

asset_specs.name: Bread
asset_specs.height: About one adult hand-length long; can be held in one hand.
asset_specs.spec: The bread is a small oval wheat loaf with a rounded top and a flat underside. Its golden-brown crust has three diagonal scoring marks, and its size is about one adult hand-length from end to end. It is whole, unwrapped, and unsliced.

asset_specs.name: Small cake
asset_specs.height: About an adult palm across and three finger-widths tall; fits in one hand.
asset_specs.spec: The small cake is round, with straight pale-golden sides and a gently domed, golden-brown top. It is about an adult palm across and three finger-widths tall. It is plain and whole, without icing, fruit, candles, or a wrapper.

asset_specs.name: Wicker basket
asset_specs.height: A child-sized carrying basket, about two adult hand-lengths wide; its handle can be gripped in one hand.
asset_specs.spec: The basket is a shallow oval basket woven from honey-brown wicker, with a sturdy braided rim and one fixed arched handle. Its body is about two adult hand-lengths wide and one hand-length deep, excluding the handle. It has no lid or lining, and holds a small oval loaf with three diagonal scoring marks beside a palm-sized, plain round golden cake.

asset_specs.name: Grandmother
asset_specs.height: A petite grown woman, slightly shorter than an average grown person.
asset_specs.spec: Grandmother is a petite, slender elderly woman with a slightly stooped posture, fair wrinkled skin, kind hazel eyes, and small round wire spectacles. Her silver-white hair is parted in the middle and gathered into a small low bun. She wears a loose, ankle-length warm-cream nightgown with long sleeves and a small buttoned collar, together with plain brown slippers. Her head is uncovered.

asset_specs.name: Wolf
asset_specs.height: A very large natural wolf, reaching about a grown person's waist at the shoulder when on all fours.
asset_specs.spec: The wolf is a natural four-legged animal, not a person-shaped wolf, and wears no clothing. He has a long, lean body, a deep chest, powerful legs, large paws, and a long bushy tail. His fur is gray-brown, darkest along his back and tail tip, with warm-cream fur on his throat, chest, and underside. His face has a long muzzle, a black nose, large upright pointed ears, amber eyes, and prominent white pointed teeth.

asset_specs.name: Daisies picked by Red
asset_specs.height: Each daisy is about an adult hand-length tall; the small group fits in one hand.
asset_specs.spec: The flowers are a small group of wild daisies with slender green stems and small, narrow green leaves. Each flower has one golden-yellow central disk surrounded by a single ring of narrow white petals. Their stems vary slightly in length, and they have no ribbon or other binding.

asset_specs.name: Grandmother’s nightcap
asset_specs.height: An adult-sized cap that fits in two cupped hands.
asset_specs.spec: The nightcap is made of plain white cotton, with a soft rounded crown gathered into a narrow band. A small white ruffle runs around its opening, and two thin white ties extend from the sides. It has no colored trim, pattern, or pom-pom.

asset_specs.name: Grandmother’s quilt
asset_specs.height: A full-length single-bed quilt; folded, it makes a substantial armful.
asset_specs.spec: The quilt is a large rectangular patchwork cover with a regular grid of equal-sized moss-green and warm-cream squares, interrupted by a few muted brick-red squares. It has a broad warm-cream binding, a plain warm-cream reverse, and small, evenly spaced cream quilting stitches. Its padding is moderately thick, giving it a soft but not bulky shape.

asset_specs.name: Woodcutter
asset_specs.height: A tall, broad grown man, about a head taller than an average grown woman.
asset_specs.spec: The woodcutter is a broad-shouldered, sturdy man with fair skin, brown eyes, short dark-brown hair, and a neatly trimmed brown beard. He wears a moss-green shirt with sleeves rolled to his elbows, a dark-brown waistcoat, charcoal-brown trousers, and heavy brown leather boots. A wide brown leather belt carries a large pair of closed dull-gray iron shears, secured blade-down through a leather loop. The shears have two oval handles, a central pivot, and long tapered blades.

asset_specs.name: Pair of shears
asset_specs.height: About one and a half adult hand-lengths long; operated with one adult hand.
asset_specs.spec: The shears are a large, sturdy pair made entirely of dull-gray iron, about one and a half adult hand-lengths long. Two oval finger loops connect through a round central pivot to long, broad blades that taper to narrow tips. They are normally closed and have no colored grips or decorative markings.

asset_specs.name: Stones placed in the wolf’s belly
asset_specs.height: Six stones, each about the size of an adult palm; each fits in one hand.
asset_specs.spec: The group consists of six solid, palm-sized stones with irregular rounded shapes and gently flattened faces. They range from slate gray to warm gray-brown, with small darker speckles and no sharp points. Their surfaces are plain, without writing, carvings, or crystals.

asset_specs.name: Sewing needle
asset_specs.height: About half the length of an adult little finger; held between fingertips.
asset_specs.spec: The sewing needle is a straight, slender silver-colored steel needle, about half the length of an adult little finger. It has a sharp point at one end and a small elongated eye at the other. It is unthreaded and has no handle or attached ornament.

asset_specs.name: Sewing thread
asset_specs.height: The spool is about an adult thumb's length tall and fits easily in one hand.
asset_specs.spec: The sewing thread is strong warm-cream cotton wound neatly around a small honey-brown wooden spool. The spool is about an adult thumb's length tall, with a narrow cylindrical middle and wider circular ends. A short loose end rests against the wound thread, unattached to a needle.
